subject: Workshop announcement: Cleaning and reshaping data in R

messages.author: 532359cb4f30370a
messages.subject: Workshop announcement: Cleaning and reshaping data in R
parts:
Hey D-RUG fam,
UC Davis DataLab is offering a pair of free workshops next week where you can come learn about using R to do data cleaning and preparation. The workshops will be held Tuesday and Thursday (3/5 and 3/7) from 10-noon, and will be hybrid in-person in the DataLab Classroom (360 Shields Library) and live-streamed on Zoom. Your registration puts you in both sessions, which are taught by me and by Nick Ulle.

Registration link is here (the text includes some misinformation about the dates of the workshops, but rest assured that they are for March 5 and March 7): https://reservations.library.ucdavis.edu/event/11931815

I hope to see you there!
-Wes
